identity.name: Argus
identity.description: Originally synthesized for solo snipers operating in hostile territory, this psycho-stimulant radically accelerates cognitive processing speed. Named after the hundred-eyed Greek giant, ARG-100 makes it virtually impossible for an enemy to catch the user off guard. It grants razor-sharp attention to environmental details, microscopic aiming precision, and sustained aerobic stamina, though it leaves the operator suffering from severe paranoia and visual snow.
